$comment: A deterministic demo skill: an event-driven agent workflow (observe, classify, assert, decide, execute virtually) that returns an auditable evidence chain. Pushed with `gadgets push`, never bundled.
title: Breakout Workflow
description: Deterministic breakout/breakdown agent workflow over a bar series: classifies the latest bar, checks risk assertions, decides, fills virtually, and returns an evidence chain. Can run on a schedule, with an optional model review of runs that acted.

REVIEW_MODEL.title: Review model
REVIEW_MODEL.description: Optional. Writes a short reviewer note on scheduled runs that bought, sold or were blocked; never makes decisions.
